title: Cha Cheong-hwa joins SBS drama 9 to 6 as corporate support head
text:
Cha Cheong-hwa joins SBS drama 9 to 6 as corporate support head - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 7일(토) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Cha Cheong-hwa joins SBS drama 9 to 6 as corporate support head 
 입력 2026.11.05. 18:30 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 Actor Cha Cheong-hwa joins "9 to 6."
 On the 5th, her agency Management Siseon said, "Actor Cha Cheong-hwa has been cast in SBS' "9 to 6." Please look forward to Cha Cheong-hwa returning with a new look as she works alongside Park Minyoung, Yook Sung-jae and Go Soo," it said.
 "9 to 6" is SBS's new Wednesday-Thursday drama about a rational woman who has proven herself through work, who meets a kind and emotional man and, as a "ONF woravel" romance, rewrites the standards of work, love and happiness.
 Cha Cheong-hwa plays Lee Jung-eun, the head of corporate support who reads the flow of power within the company more sensitively than anyone. Jung-eun is a character who values internal relationships and social skills over ability, showing strict loyalty to superiors while taking an oppressive attitude toward subordinates.
 In particular, she will openly check Kang I-ji (played by Park Minyoung), who was demoted to the corporate support team, forming a tense confrontational dynamic and showcasing an antagonistic chemistry. In addition, viewers' expectations are heightened by Cha Cheong-hwa's skillful acting that will vividly portray Jung-eun's duplicitous aspects.
 Meanwhile, SBS' "9 to 6" will premiere on the 25th at 9 p.m.
